transcript.text: Thanks for calling Summit Air, you've reached our automated assistant. How can I help?
Hi, I'd like to schedule a fall tune-up for my heating system.
Could you please tell me the address where the work will be done, including ZIP code?
Sure, it's 33 Shore Road, Bay Shore, New York 11706.
Thanks, we do serve your area. Can you tell me a little about what's going on with your heating that you'd like the tune-up for?
I just want to get the fall tune-up done before the cold weather starts.
We have openings tomorrow between noon and 2 in the afternoon, or 4 to 6 in the evening, and also on Thursday between 8 and 10 in the morning. Which works best for you?
I think the evening slot tomorrow between 4 and 6 works for me. By the way, there was a rotten-egg smell in the basement this morning but it went away.

This could be a gas leak, so please leave the house now and take everyone with you. Don't touch light switches, appliances or phones on your way out. Once you're outside and away from the house, call nine-one-one, or National Grid at one, eight hundred, four nine zero, zero zero four five. Don't go back in until they tell you it's safe.
Okay, I'll leave the house right now. Thanks for the instructions. Goodbye.
Thank you for acting quickly—please stay outside and call nine-one-one right away. Goodbye.

tone.name: tone
tone.detail: The conversation was warm, clear, brief, avoided repetition and jargon, asked one thing at a time, and did not invent any facts or promises.
